mapper.select: SELECT s.device_id AS deviceId, s.device_code AS deviceCode, s.sensor_type AS sensorType, s.sensor_name AS sensorName, s.value AS value, s.unit AS unit, s.data_time AS dataTime, s.quality_flag AS qualityFlag FROM agri_prod_sensor_data s JOIN ( SELECT device_id, MAX(data_time) AS latest FROM agri_prod_sensor_data WHERE device_id IN #{id} GROUP BY device_id ) m ON m.device_id = s.device_id AND m.latest = s.data_time
